description: lib.rs Dispatcher::dispatch wraps each handler call in tokio::task::spawn, converting panics to JoinError and mapping them to serverFail rather than crashing the connection. This is the correct design for a production JMAP server: a handler bug in one method call should not terminate the batch or the connection. The security test (panic_message_not_in_response) enforces that the panic payload does not leak to the client. A contributor might suggest removing the spawn to reduce overhead; this should be defended on the grounds that panic safety at the connection level is more important than the overhead of spawning a task per method call.
title: Dispatcher panic isolation via tokio::task::spawn is the right design
